modules.name: Agefield High Rock the School Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start Sam's senior year with the core systems explained in a practical order. This guide covers school attendance, free exploration, earning pocket money, and preparing for missions without inventing mechanics the game does not have.

highlights.detail: Learn the weekday time and school system, which keeps Sam in lessons until the afternoon when he attends class.
Balance attendance against skipping class; good grades earn pocket money, while side missions provide another way to earn cash.
Explore the school campus, two neighborhoods, town center, and countryside when Sam is not in class or a main mission.
Spend earnings at shops on useful and cosmetic options including bicycles, clothes, hairstyles, tattoos, and accessories.

modules.name: Agefield High Rock the School Mission Walkthrough
modules.description: Follow the complete story structure and optional activity checklist for Sam's final months at Agefield High. The game officially contains 32 main missions and 15 side missions or activities across an estimated 8–10-hour story.

highlights.label: Main Story
highlights.detail: 32 main missions follow Sam, Kale, and Axel as they attempt their Rock the School plan.

highlights.label: Side Content
highlights.detail: 15 side missions and activities provide optional objectives and ways to earn cash.

highlights.label: Playtime
highlights.detail: The developer estimates 8–10 hours for the coming-of-age story.

highlights.label: Completion
highlights.detail: Completing every mini mission and activity unlocks the Hard worker Steam achievement.

modules.name: Agefield High Rock the School Collectibles Guide
modules.description: Track the collectible sets tied directly to Steam achievements. The official achievement list confirms five completion categories, making this a useful checklist for players pursuing 100% completion.

highlights.label: Mayor Wellbe Autographs
highlights.detail: Collect every Mayor Wellbe autograph to unlock Hardcore Supporter.

highlights.label: Playwith Magazines
highlights.detail: Collect every Playwith Magazine to unlock Naughty boy.

highlights.label: Band Magazines
highlights.detail: Collect every Band Magazine to unlock Band geek.

highlights.label: Golden Panties
highlights.detail: Collect every golden pair to unlock the achievement named ;-).

highlights.label: Burned CDs
highlights.detail: Collect every burned CD to unlock Pirate.

highlights.label: Apple Pies
highlights.detail: Collect every apple pie to unlock Don't try it.

modules.name: Agefield High Rock the School Endings Guide
modules.description: See how the prom choice connects to the game's two confirmed endings. This spoiler-aware section separates Chloe's and Ashley's outcomes and links each route to its official Steam achievement.

highlights.label: Chloe Ending
highlights.detail: Finish the prom mission with Chloe to unlock Chloe's little guitar hero.

highlights.label: Ashley Ending
highlights.detail: Finish the prom mission with Ashley to unlock Ashley's sweet boy Sam.

highlights.label: Two Endings
highlights.detail: The developer officially confirms that the 32-mission main story has two different endings.

modules.name: Agefield High Rock the School Achievements Guide
modules.description: Work through all 11 Steam achievements using official names and unlock conditions. The list covers savings, bicycles, both prom outcomes, all side activities, and every collectible set.

highlights.label: Thrifty child
highlights.detail: Save $1000.

highlights.label: Bike enthusiast
highlights.detail: Unlock all bicycles.

highlights.label: Hard worker
highlights.detail: Complete all mini missions and activities.

highlights.label: Prom Achievements
highlights.detail: Two separate achievements track finishing the prom mission with Chloe and with Ashley.

highlights.label: Collectible Achievements
highlights.detail: Six achievements cover all autographs, Playwith Magazines, Band Magazines, golden panties, apple pies, and burned CDs.

modules.name: Agefield High Rock the School Money and Bikes Guide
modules.description: Learn the two confirmed ways to earn cash and what Sam can buy around town. This section also supports the $1000 savings achievement and the all-bicycles completion goal without claiming an unverified economy exploit.

highlights.detail: Attend lessons and earn good grades to receive pocket money.
Skip class and complete side missions when pursuing the alternative cash source described by the developer.
Save $1000 to unlock the Thrifty child achievement before spending the full balance.
Buy bicycles, clothes, hairstyles, tattoos, and accessories from shops around Agefield.
Unlock every bicycle to earn the Bike enthusiast achievement.

modules.name: Agefield High Rock the School System Requirements
modules.description: Check the current official PC specifications before installing the game. The Steam listing requires Windows 10 or 11, DirectX 12, an SSD, and 15 GB of available storage, with separate minimum and recommended hardware tiers.

highlights.label: Operating System
highlights.detail: Windows 10 or 11 with a 64-bit processor and operating system.

highlights.label: Minimum CPU
highlights.detail: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X or Intel Core i7-7700K.

highlights.label: Minimum GPU
highlights.detail: NVIDIA GTX 1070 8GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB.

highlights.label: Minimum Memory
highlights.detail: 16 GB RAM.

highlights.label: Recommended Hardware
highlights.detail: AMD Ryzen 5 7600X or Intel Core i7-12700K, 32 GB RAM, and NVIDIA RTX 3080 or AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: 15 GB available space with an SSD required.
